_about: Read-only snapshot (10-02) of Will's real goal rows and memory rows on prod, for T69-C. The 08-09 goal ('Bench 315 goal pushed back past mid-August; will set new bench target after maxing out tomorrow ...') had no target date, was never superseded (supersede-on-write shipped 09-29), and so stayed a live goal for seven weeks; the 09-27 weekly letter quoted it. On main nothing ever asked about it. T69-C: the review asks about it at the next check-in, and a new note with 'tomorrow' cannot be saved without a date.

athlete.injury_history: Rehabbing from inflamed knees and strengthening weak core/low back

goals.goal_text: My goals are reflected by my programming. I want to bench 315 by the end of this summer (mid August) and regain squat strength (I’ve had to take a break because of over working them due to weightlifting competitions) and build my lower back and core strength and bring my pull strength up to the same level of my back squat strength or more (185kg-200kg)

Bench 315 goal pushed back past mid-August; will set new bench target after maxing out tomorrow. Squat and deadlift goals remain the same. Next block heavy on maxes; planning to split volume across two weeks to manage CNS strain.
Shift focus to healing left pec and strengthening front squat, posterior chain, and overhead barbell strength this block
Healing left pec, building up clean and jerk and posterior chain and front squat

memory.content: On Aug 25 front squat session, Will stopped climbing (70/100/120kg) due to knee irritation, one week after flagging knee soreness from squat volume on Aug 22.

Knees have flagged on squat volume twice in two weeks: Back Squat Aug 22 and Front Squat Aug 25. One-week train-around plan in effect: lighter/knee-friendly squat variants, escalate to professional if still barking after Sep 1.
On Aug 28, Will swapped Back Squat 4x4@137.5kg for a snatch climb to protect his knees. Front squat/back squat still the flagged knee-irritation lifts under the train-around plan.
Watching: squat (pain) reported 2026-09-01 - a repeat within 2 weeks earns a program rec
Knees have flagged on squat volume three times: Back Squat Aug 22, Front Squat Aug 25, Front Squat Sep 1 (stopped at 120kg). Escalating past train-around, front squat pulled from program this block.

Front Squat, Snatch Pull and other main lift loads logged Sep 1 were in kg, not lbs as auto-labeled (Front Squat 2x1 @ 100/120kg, Snatch Pull 4x2 @ 110/120/120/120kg). Back Extensions stayed lbs (90lbs).

letter_0927.body: Bench 315 by mid-August: no bench press logged this window, can't measure progress, and that target's already been pushed to fall per your own notes. Snatch/clean & jerk building goal: total sits at 248kg per your maxes sheet, complex and snatch pull work this week held at prescribed intensity, on track. Pull strength vs back squat (185-200kg target): no deadlift or clean pull logged this week, need that data next time to compare.
